svg.text: The Provincial Wordmark consists of the stylized flag

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: accompanied by the capital letters BC.

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace
ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: separately or in conjunction with the Stylized Coat of Arms.

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: Where the symbols are used together, they should be widely

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace
ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: on the cover and back page of a publica-

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace
ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: Where used alone, the wordmark need not be accompanied

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: by the words Province of British Columbia when the name of the

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: ministry and minister are added to complete government

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace
ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: The Stylized Flag and Theme may appear without the letters BC

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: when it is used in conjunction with the provincial theme line

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: "That's the BC Spirit!" to identify major projects or

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace
ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: Further instructions on the use of the wordmark are contained

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: in the Graphics Guide to Official Application of the B.C. Flag

text.font-family: ManualKit Courier, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: Symbol, obtainable from the office of the Deputy Minister,
